entries.why: the init lock of Korg's SD driver (tools/patch/script_menu.s SD_INIT_LOCK): on the Sampler set to 1 by 0xC001DB18, read by 0xC001DB3C, cleared by 0xC001DB60; the synth's three functions at 0xC0019440, 0xC0019464 and 0xC0019488 are the same code with the same literal 0xC031BEEC (read in both images). Emulator: never-ready card sets it on both builds
